P.name: Martial Cadence
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Jarvan IV's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} are empowered to deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} equal to {{as|8% of the target's '''current''' health}}, with a minimum threshold of 20 and capped at 400 against non-{{tip|champion}} targets.
P.description2: This effect cannot occur on the same target more than once every few seconds.

Q.name: Dragon Strike
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Jarvan IV''' extends his lance in the target direction, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit and inflicting them with {{sti|armor penetration|{{as|armor reduction}}}} for 3 seconds.
Q.leveling: {{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|90 to 250}} {{as|(+ 145% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}{{st|Armor Reduction|{{as|{{ap|10 to 26}}% of target's armor}}}}
Q.description2: If the lance connects with a deployed ''{{ai|Demacian Standard|Jarvan IV}}'', '''Jarvan IV''' {{tip|dashes}} to its location, {{tip|airborne|knocking up}} nearby enemies around him and along his path for {{fd|0.75}} seconds.
Q.description3: '''''Jarvan IV''' can cast any of his [[champion ability|abilities]] during the dash.''

W.name: Golden Aegis
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Jarvan IV''' {{tip|slow|slows}} all nearby enemies for 2 seconds.
W.description2: '''Jarvan IV''' also grants himself a {{tip|shield}} for 4 seconds, increased by {{as|{{fd|1.3}}% of his '''maximum''' health}} for each enemy {{tip|champion}} hit by ''Golden Aegis''.

E.name: Demacian Standard
E.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Jarvan IV''' throws a Demacian flag to the target location, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies within the area.
E.description3: The flag then remains for 8 seconds, granting {{tip|sight}} of its surroundings and providing an {{tip|aura}} that grants ''Demacian Standard's'' passive {{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}} to all nearby allied champions as well as '''Jarvan IV''' {{tt|himself|See notes}}.

R.name: Cataclysm
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Jarvan IV''' {{tip|dash|leaps}} with {{tip|displacement immunity}} to the target enemy champion's location over {{fd|0.35}} seconds, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to all nearby enemies upon arrival.
R.description2: Upon impact, he creates a circle of impassable terrain that {{tip|airborne|knocks aside}} enemies within the perimeter over {{fd|0.15}} seconds, knocking them out of the circle if they are on the outer edge and pulling them in otherwise. The terrain lasts for {{fd|3.5}} seconds and grants {{tip|sight}} of the area. ''Cataclysm'' can be recast after {{fd|0.75}} seconds while the terrain is present.
R.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Jarvan IV''' destroys the terrain created by ''Cataclysm''.
